token_usage_and_cost.measurement_method: token_counts_times_price (exact per-turn input_tokens, cache_read_tokens, and output_tokens from each agent's transcript.jsonl multiplied by published tiered per-token API rates; Antigravity executes on plan quota and exposes no USD billing page in the workspace)
token_usage_and_cost.billing_mechanism: Antigravity executes on plan quota (visible in the Antigravity IDE Model Selector / Settings quota indicator and swarm{action:'models'}); API-equivalent USD spend is computed from exact logged tokens in transcript.jsonl.

wave3_neon_completion.pre_indexing: src/document_indexer.py (MacOSPDFKitProvider + DocumentCacheStore, 6,615 physical pages -> 1,749 pages_selected [26.4%], 4,039 pages_deferred [61.1%], 827 pages_without_text [12.5%])
wave3_neon_completion.billing_mechanism: Executed on Antigravity plan quota (no per-token USD API invoice). Historical Wave 1 + Wave 2 token-counts-times-price USD totals ($139.60 model-matched / $131.45 uniform Gemini / $191.83 conservative across 348 trials) are preserved unchanged above.

deviations_from_instructions: Wave 1 (2026-11-14T01:21:51Z to 2026-11-14T03:13:29Z) halted at 62 / 402 primary trials under the initial $18/$20 cap ($26.68 uniform-$1.25 / $38.49 conservative-$2.00). Work resumed at 2026-11-14T13:42:19Z under follow-up instructions specifying a $150.00 hard cap for all further work in order: (1) remaining 32 / 40 sample primary trials, (2) all 40 / 40 independent second-pass trials, (3) shard-04..shard-20 skipping sample trials, stopping after shard-17 at 2026-11-14T20:38:01Z when further-work conservative-$2.00 spend reached $148.81 ($101.79 uniform-$1.25). On 2026-11-17, under delivery instructions specifying a $150.00 total-census cap counting everything already spent and a $140.00 batch-launch stop threshold, cumulative spend from 2026-11-14T01:21:51Z through 2026-11-17T14:02:56Z stood at $139.60 USD (model-matched standard API rates), $131.45 USD (uniform Gemini $1.25 schedule, where 18-trial shard-18 plus merge overhead would exceed $140.00), and $191.83 USD (conservative $2.00 schedule); therefore no new batch was launched and 54 / 402 primary trials (shard-18, shard-19, shard-20) remain unstarted.

Added rule-census-20261114/STATUS.md on 2026-11-17 per the delivery-task instructions (whereas the original census prompt specified four output files only). On 2026-11-14, commit 03359fbb88fec30839f686357c51cb6ccd9d8263 also updated .gitignore to ignore pdfs/ per the 2026-11-14 continuation instructions; .gitignore was not modified on 2026-11-17.

Downloaded PDFs were stored locally at rule-census-20261114/pdfs/{NCT_ID}/{filename} to prevent filename collisions across trials and excluded from git commit/push per instructions, while retaining the exact ClinicalTrials.gov filename in documents.jsonl and locations.jsonl.
Standalone Informed Consent Form (ICF) PDFs in largeDocs with both hasProtocol=false and hasSap=false were excluded because doc_type is strictly protocol|sap|combined.

Wave 3 completion (2026-11-21): Following implementation of the offline indexing and verification modules (src/document_indexer.py and src/citation_verifier.py), the remaining 54 / 402 primary-pass trials (shard-18, shard-19, shard-20) were completed via 6 balanced 9-trial shards (neon-shard-1..neon-shard-6) running on Antigravity plan quota with gemini-4-neon-high against pre-indexed PDFKit page caches, independently verified (909 / 909 [100.0%] exact_ws citations, 0 errors, 0 warnings), and appended byte-for-byte after the untouched Wave 1/2 records (678 documents.jsonl rows and 4,718 locations.jsonl rows, preserving the 7-row NCT01265849 outcome 1 note discrepancy unmodified).
